_comment: Branch protection ruleset for the main branch. Applied via scripts/apply-ruleset.sh.
name: main-branch-protection

rules._comment: Prevent force pushes to main — history must be linear and immutable.
Prevent direct deletion of the main branch.
Require a pull request before merging into main.
Require all three CI status checks to pass before merge.

required_status_checks._comment: Linting, typechecking, unit tests, formatting, and migration immutability checks.
Full project build validation (apps and lambdas).
Copilot / bot review gate — set by copilot-auto-approve.yml. Ensures every PR has been reviewed by the bot reviewer before merge.

bypass_actors._comment: Allow repository admins to bypass in emergencies (e.g., hotfixes).
